build_sum_arbitrary_loss: build a SumArbitraryLoss that sums multiple weighted ClassyLoss instances on the same prediction and target
create_loss_from_config: create a SumArbitraryLoss from a config dict with a list of loss configs and optional weights
register_sum_arbitrary_loss: register the SumArbitraryLoss class under the name sum_arbitrary in the ClassyVision loss registry
compute_weighted_loss_sum: compute the forward pass that applies each loss to prediction and target then sums with weights
review_loss_initialization: review the SumArbitraryLoss init that defaults weights to ones when no weights tensor is provided
